verdict.rationale: iTerm2 is a local macOS terminal emulator that installs and runs on the user's own Mac ("It works on Macs with macOS 10.14 or newer"). It has no hosted or server-side core that could be self-hosted, so the self-hosting axis is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows a hosted service component that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
